## Pre-PR Checklist

- [ ] Company Research Template V1 sequence followed
- [ ] V2 Design System Gold Gate checked
- [ ] latest IR / DART / official releases verified
- [ ] valuation reference date stated
- [ ] backlog quality explained, not just backlog size
- [ ] segment vs consolidated economics separated where needed
- [ ] Bull / Base / Bear conditions explicit
- [ ] Fact / Interpretation / Scenario / Action completed
- [ ] Pillar/Guide internal link added
- [ ] adjacent company or compare hub internal link added
- [ ] title/description tested for 390px-safe wrapping
- [ ] no literal markdown markers visible in built HTML
- [ ] Astro build / dependency audit pass
